parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The natural language of the request and response. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese (default)
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: LocalVpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the local VPC.

parameters.name: PeerVpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the peer VPC.

parameters.name: VpcFirewallId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the VPC firewall.

>  You can call the [DescribeVpcFirewallList](~~342932~~) operation to query the instance IDs of VPC firewalls.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw describe-vpc-firewall-detail --lang zh --vpc-firewall-id vfw-m5e7dbc4y0000 --local-vpc-id vpc-8vbwbo90rq0anm6t0000 --peer-vpc-id vpc-90rq0anm6t8vbwbo0000 --region cn-hangzhou
